axisMinimum: {axis} minimum must be less than its maximum.
calendarBounds: Horizontal bounds are outside the supported calendar.
numericLog: Logarithmic horizontal axes require numeric data.
scatterCoordinates: Scatter plots need numeric or date coordinates.
linearBars: Bars and filled areas require a linear vertical axis.
seriesDistinct: Give each series a distinct name.
pointCoordinate: {series}, row {row}: enter a valid horizontal coordinate.
pointLogValue: {series}, row {row}: logarithmic values and uncertainty bounds must be positive.
pointLogCoordinate: {series}, row {row}: logarithmic coordinates must be positive.
seriesMeasured: {series}: add at least one measured value.
csvSeries: Row {row}: enter a series name and four columns.
csvColumns: Row {row} has a different number of columns.
csvCoordinate: Row {row} has an invalid horizontal coordinate.
csvGap: Row {row}, {column}: enter a number or leave a gap.
quotedAdjacent: Line {line}: unexpected text beside a quoted field.
quotedUnclosed: Line {line}: a quoted field was not closed.
tableRequired: Choose a file or paste a table first.
tableLimit: Import up to 16 MiB of text at a time.
tableMinimum: Choose one or two minimum columns.
tableColumns: No separate columns found. Choose the separator used in your file.
tableWidth: Line {line}: found {found} columns; expected {expected}. Check the separator and quoted fields.
tableRows: The table has column names but no data rows.
pointLimit: The figure has too many points or labels. Summarize rows or choose fewer series.
mappingOperation: Choose how to summarize the rows.
mappingValues: Choose at least one numeric value column to plot.
mappingUncertainty: Choose valid value and uncertainty columns.
mappingPolicy: Choose a valid exact resource policy.
mappingProjection: Choose valid exact origin and positive scale settings; horizontal transforms require numeric coordinates.
transformedReplace: A transformed import replaces the figure so every coordinate has the same meaning.
numberOrGap: Expected a number or an empty cell for a gap.
fewerSeries: Choose fewer series for this figure.
coordinateDate: Enter an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a timestamp with a time zone.
groupName: This row needs a series name, or choose no grouping.
uncertaintyNumber: Uncertainty must be a non-negative number or an empty cell.
uncertaintyValue: Uncertainty needs a measured value in the same row.
missingExcluded: {count} empty values excluded; groups with no values stay empty.
appendType: Adding series requires the same horizontal coordinate type as the figure.
summaryReplace: Summary imports replace series so the calculation remains explicit. Use a separate figure to compare different calculations.
repeatedCoordinates: {count} repeated coordinates are retained as separate measurements.
overlappingBars: Bars at the same coordinate will overlap; use scatter to see individual observations.
backwardsCoordinates: Coordinates go backwards in file order. Choose Sort by coordinate to connect them in ascending order, or use scatter.
